Commentary.Commentary: So, that is it from this game! Mahmudullah has been given the trophy and now he along with his team celebrate the series win. All Bangladesh then in this tour, they won the Tests, the ODIs and now the T20Is too. That is it from this game and this series. However, if you haven't had enough of cricketing action, you can catch all the action from the India game which begins shortly. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Mahmudullah, The winning Captain of Bangladesh says the boys showed a lot of character and everyone contributed, Shamim played a good knock down the end and it was a combined effort in the end. States when you are chasing a big score, you need partnerships and also rotate strike well, they wanted to build partnerships and that was their plan. Adds, Sarkar scored when it was needed and he is pleased they could chase this down.
Soumya Sarkar has been given the Man of the Match for today and the Man of the Series!

Post Match Presentation - Zimbabwe Captain Sikandar Raza says they have shown improvement in every game and he felt the score was defendable on this track. States he was pretty confident about winning the game till the 15th over but the last couple of overs strayed away from the plans. Adds it is never easy to play a series without the seniors but seeing the youngsters step up was good and he hopes they can do better. Admits they need to bowl less extras and if they can do that, they can be a better side.

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, Bangladesh scored a massive 193 thanks to a combined batting effort from their side. However, it was chased down quite easily in the end from Bangladesh who's batters to rose to the occasion.

The Zimbabwe bowling was not at its best! Far too many boundary balls and some extras too in between which just released the pressure. They did manage to take wickets here and there but could never build pressure on the visitors by bowling a few tight overs. Raza will not be pleased as he would have backed his bowlers to defend this.

What a fine, fine chase from Bangladesh! They truly deserve the series especially after chasing down such a massive total. They though did not get off to the best of starts as they lost Naim early. However, Shakib and Sarkar got things back on track before Shakib departed. Sarkar though continued and along with Mahmudullah took his side on top. Sarkar was departed after getting to his half ton, Afif also did not last for long out there. Shamim though came in and played a beauty of an innings along with Mahmudullah to take his side over the line.
And There it is! Full toss, on the pads. Shamim Hossain flicks this towards the leg side for an easy single. And Bangladesh have won the match by 5 wickets, and they also take the series 2-1.
FOUR! Quicker ball, outside off. Shamim Hossain smacks this straight down the ground past the bowler for a boundary. And Bangladesh need just 1 run to win now.
BYE! Shoriful Islam dances down the track. Blessing Muzarabani bangs this ball short and Shamim misses the hook. The ball goes through to the keeper, and they take a quick single.
Good length ball, around off. Guided towards third man for a single. Sensible stuff this from Nurul Hasan.

OUT! CAUGHT! Full ball, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to slice it over third man, but gets an oustside edge and the ball goes towards the right of the keeper who dives and completes a very good low catch. So the Captain has to depart.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: Slower ball, on off. Shamim Hossain cuts it late towards the short third man fielder.
FOUR! Full ball, on off. Shamim Hossain swings hard, gets a thick outside edge and the ball races away to the boundary.
Short of a length ball, outside off. Mahmudullah pulls it hard but straight to the deep mid-wicket fielder. They take one.

FOUR! In the gap again and this is probably the over which seals the deal for Bangladesh. 15 from it and just the 13 needed in 12. A short one, Hossain pulls it uppishly, he does not hit it very well but in the gap in the mid-wicket region for another boundary.

FOUR! Shamim you beaty! We say it again, what a cameo this is! What innovation. Outrageous! He plays the reverse sweep, he gets it past the short third man fielder and into the fence. Finding the gaps nicely.
FOUR! Thumped away! There is the needed boundary and this is a really good innings from Shamim so far. It is short and outside off, Hossain slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Two! Good running! This is short and wide outside off, Hossain looks to cut but this goes off the underedge on the off side for one. That was very wide, he could have left it but went for it.
Just the one again! ON middle, Mahmudullah swings, this goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for one.
Dion Myers has been brought back into the attack.
Tried to be cheeky but it does not come off! It is a slower one outside off, Mahmudullah gets into positon early to play the scoop but it hits the glove and goes to the keeper on the bounce.
That is rash! Not needed! Comes down the track and this is a slower one outside off. Shamim swings but misses.

FOUR! Put away! Really clever from Shamim! He walks across and Chatara bowls it well wide outside off, he did not look to whack it over the leg side but instead just guided it past point, third man was in the ring so another crucial boundary.
Just the one this time! It is a slower one, Mahmudullah looks to whip it again but this time it goes more off the inner half towards deep square leg for one.
SIX! NAILED! Trademark Mahmudullah! This is where he loves the ball! He walks across and this is full and on middle, this is heaved over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Just the single! Shorter again and outside off, Hossain cuts it towards point for one more. The good thing is Mahmudullah is back on strike.
Tendai Chatara comes back into the attack.
A dot! Gold dust at the moment! It is short and outside off, Hossain slashes but misses.
One more single! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard through mid-wicket for one.
Just the single from the Free Hit! It is full and on middle, Mahmudullah looks to go over long on but does not time it. Just one.

NO BALL! This could prove very costly as a Free Hit is coming up! Shamim is taken by surprise. It is a high full toss on the body, Shamim looks to pull but is late on the shot, it goes off the glove towards square leg for one.
Who will come out to bat next? Shamim Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Masakadza strikes and once again, just as the game seems to be slipping away, Zimbabwe strike and are back into the contest! Really accurate stuff! Saw the batter move across and fires in a yorker on the leg pole. Afif looks to sweep but misses and it hits the leg stumps. A short but sweet innings comes to an end but Bangladesh would have loved for him to stay out there for longer. 44 needed in 26.
SIX! Nailed! There is the pressure releaser! That is beautifully timed. This is fuller and on off, Afif lofts it over the long off fence for a biggie. 150 up for Bangladesh.
Just the one again! Shuffles across and sweeps but towards short fine leg.
Well bowled! Hossain looks to play the reverse sweep but this is very full and on the pads, it is squeezed out towards point for one.
In the blockhole. Mahmudullah somehow manages to dig this one out back towards the bowler.
Back of a length ball, outside off. Mahmudullah gets down on one knee to scoop it but gets the toe end of the bat and the ball goes back at the bowler.
Length ball, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to heave it on the leg side but misses it.
Mahmudullah advances down the track and slogs hard but misses.
Gpod length ball, on off. Tapped towards backward point for a single.
Good length ball, on off. Mahmudullah pulls it towards square leg for one.
SIX! WOW! That made a cracking sound! Good length ball, on off. Afif Hossain smacks this over the deep mid-wicket fielder for a maximum. Gets off the mark in some style.
Length ball, on the pads. Mahmudullah flicks it to the deep sqaure leg fielder for one.
Good length ball, on off. Mahmudullah defends it.

OUT! CAUGHT! Full ball, outside off. Soumya Sarkar looks to loft it over the long on fielder. Gets the bottom of the bat and the ball goes high up in the air. Substitute fielder Tarisai Musakanda makes no mistake at long on.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Tarisai Musakanda b Luke Jongwe

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Full toss, outside off. Soumya Sarkar inside edges it past the keeper for a boundary. The keeper dives but the ball beats him.

Slower ball, outside off. Mahmudullah comes down the track and heaves it wide of the long on fielder. He wants two but Soumya Sarkar sends him back. Mahmudullah is half way down the pitch. The fielder throws the ball towards the bowler at the non-striker's end. Mahmudullah turns back and runs to the non-striker's end. Looks like his dive saved him in the end.
Good length ball, outside off. Soumya Sarkar looks to cut it late but misses.
FOUR! Slower ball, outside off. Soumya Sarkar pulls it just over the jumping deep mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Soumya Sarkar looks to slog but misses.
Good length ball, on the stumps. Turned towards on side for a couple.
FOUR! Short and wide. Soumya Sarkar smacks it straight over the bowler's head and it beats the diving long off fielder.
Back of a length ball, outsid eoff. Soumya Sarkar pulls it towards long on for a couple of runs. Excellent fielding in the deep.
Full ball, outside off. Mahmudullah drives it towards sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Good length ball, on off. Guided towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Short and wide. Soumya Sarkar cuts it behind point for a boundary. Gets to his FIFTY in style. What an innings this has been so far!
Good length ball, on off. Turned towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Full toss, on the pads. Mahmudullah flicks it fine and beats the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Good length ball, outside off. Flicked towards mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Two more! End of another good over! On middle, Sarkar pushes it with soft hands down to long on for two.
FOUR! Playing with the field is Sarkar! Really good. All of a sudden, he is timing it well! On the pads, Sarkar sweeps, gets it behind the man at short fine leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Smashed away! Welcome boundary! He had no problem in timing that! This is shorter and on middle, this is pulled wide of the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Dot! Sarkar is struggling to time the ball out there! This is very full and on off, he looks to push it through covers but this goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

Sarkar's pad saves him there! He skips down the track and this is fired on the pads. Sarkar looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and goes a little away from the keeper. It goes off the outer part of the glove towards short third man for one. Leg bye signaled.

FOUR! Just short and a boundary! A good finish to the over for Bangladesh! Mahmudullah steps down the track and this is banged in short. He pulls it uppishly. It goes towards deep mid-wicket The fielder runs in and dives forward but the ball lands in front of him, does back and into the fence. Spoils the over. A good one for Bangladesh.
And again! Really swings hard to this ball outside off, mistimes it down to long off for one.
Another dot! Sarkar is trying to hit the ball a little too hard! This is outside off, he looks to slap it but it goes off the under edge back to the bowler.
Sloppy from Zimbabwe! On the pads, this is worked towards short fine leg. The fielder there misfields and they go for the second. The throw is also a poor one and the third is taken.
Really well bowled again! On middle and angling in, this skids through. Sarkar looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls towards the off side for one.
The physio is out! Sarkar may have hurt himself. It did hit him where there is no padding.

A loud appeal from the bowler but nothing! Outside off and on a length. Sarkar comes across and looks to heave it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but turned down. Impact was outside off.
Another single! On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one. So that five wides is what ruined the over. 113 needed in 66.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

FIVE WIDES! That is a poor delivery, he may have thought Mahmudullah was going to run at him. He fires it very wide outside off. The batter lets it be. The keeper has no chance at all and it goes to the third man fence. Bonus runs.
Well bowled! He sees Mahmudullah shuffle in and look to go for a slog sweep so fires it on middle, Mahmudullah defends it.
On middle, Sarkar eases it down to long on for one more.
Flatter and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Almost another one! Flatter and outside off, Mahmudullah looks to cut but this goes close past the off pole.
A short one and on middle, Mahmudullah is off the mark as he pulls it through mid-wicket for one. A huge over but the wicket of Shakib in it.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Jonger has the last laugh and it is a timely wicket for his side and a huge one. Shakib was looking dangerous. This is a slower one, fuller and on off. Shakib looks to go big again, this time tries to go over long off. He though gets more height than distance and he holes out to the fielder there. Not sure if this was needed but Shakib probably wanted to make this a huge over.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Tarisai Musakanda b Luke Jongwe

Commentary.Commentary: Who will come out to bat? Mahmudullah is the new man in.
A dot! Outside off again, Hasan swings again but this time it is inside the tramline and a dot.
WIDE! Pressure getting to Jongwe. This is full and well outside off. Shakib once again swings but does not connect.

TOP EDGE AND SIX! Back-to-back biggies and this is the big over Bangladesh needed! Shakib once again walks across and this is bowled short and on the body, Shakib looks to pull but it goes off the top edge and over the fine leg fence.

SIX! Welcome biggie! A one-handed biggie! This is full and outside off, it is yet another slower one. Shakib moves across and heaves it over the long on fence. His one hand does come off but it goes all the way.
WIDE! Starts off with a slower one, well wide outside off. Left alone.
Luke Jongwe comes into the attack.
A dot to end and that is a superb over from Myers! A slower one, fuller and outside off. Sarkar slashes at it but misses.
MIstimed and two is what they get! Short and on the body, Sarkar now tries to pull, he does not get hold of it. It goes down towards long on for a couple.
Just the one again! Shorter again and outside off, this is slapped through covers for a single.
Hits the deck hard this time! Short and on off, this one skids through. Sarkar chops it on the off side for one.
Brilliant running! On middle, Sarkar pushes it down to long on. They go for one, Shakib wants a second and they complete it.
A dot to begin! This is well wide outside off. Sarkar slashes at it but misses. He wanted a wide but not given.
Dion Myers comes into the attack.
A slower ball to end the Powerplay! Sarkar is early in the pull, it goes off the toe-end through mid-wicket for one. Bangladesh are 50 for 1 after the first 6. They need another 144 in 84.
WIDE! Short but down the leg side. Left alone. Wided.
Put down again! But this too is really tough! This is fuller and on middle, Hasan smashes it back to the bowler who tries to take it with one hand but this too does not stick! It goes behind for one.

Put down! Raza puts in a tremendous effort! This is short and on middle, Sarkar looks to pull, it goes off the splice towards mid on. Raza leaps and sticks one hand up, the ball does not stay in. A single taken.
Looks to be fancy! A shorter one and on middle, Sarkar looks to upper cut it but misses.
Full and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
A slower full ball and outside off, it is jammed out towards cover for one.
Length ball, on the pads. Turned towards square leg for a single.
WIDE! Short ball, sprayed down the leg side. Called Wide.
Slower ball, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan whips it without timing towards the short fine leg fielder.
FOUR! Full ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan off drives it uppishly and the ball races away to the boundary.
Slower ball, outside off. Cut towards backward point for one.
FOUR! Soumya Sarkar makes room on the off side and lofts it over the extra cover fielder for a much needed boundary.
Good length ball, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan inside edges the flick towarda short fine leg for a single.
Back of a length ball, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan tucks it off the back foot for a single.
Short and wide. Shakib Al Hasan cuts it behind square on the off side for a couple of runs.
Good length ball, on off. Soumya Sarkar pulls it awkwardly towards long on for one.
Short ball, on leg stump. Soumya Sarkar ducks under it.
Length ball, on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan flicks it to the on side for a quick single.
Slower ball, outside off. Soumya Sarkar pushes it towards the mid off fielder.
Slower ball, on off. Soumya Sarkar looks to flick but gets a leading edge and the ball goes to mid off. They take one.
Full ball, outside off. Soumya Sarkar drives it towards mid off.
A tad short, outside off. Soumya Sarkar cuts it straight to the point fielder.
FOUR! Good length ball, outside off. Soumya Sarkar bottom edges this one and beats the keeper. The keeper fails to collect it and the ball races away to the boundary.
OUT! CAUGHT! Full ball, outside off. Mohammad Naim lofts this one high up in the air, fails to middle it and Luke Jongwe at mid off takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Luke Jongwe b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: Blessing Muzarabani comes into the attack.
Good length ball, around off. Defended towards point.
Full ball, outside off. Driven towards mid off.
Slower ball, outside off. Soumya Sarkar swings hard but misses.

FOUR BYES! That goes through! It is a short one on middle, Sarkar ducks under it. It bounces just in front of the keeper who lets it through. It goes down to the third man fence. Also, it is a no ball, so Free Hit coming up.
Slower short ball, around off. Soumya looks to pull but misses. The keeper appeals for the catch but the Umpire is not interested.
Good length ball, around off. Worked towards third man for a single.
Good length ball, around off. Mohammad Naim blocks it back at the bowler.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side. Mohammad Naim ducks under it. Called wide.
Good length ball, outside off. Punched off the back foot towards cover.
Flatter ball, on off. Soumya Sarkar looks to flick bit gets a leading edge which falls short of the point fielder.
FOUR! Tossed up, on middle. Soumya Sarkar sweeps this fine and beats the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
SIX! Tossed up, on off. Soumya Sarkar smashes this over mid off and he gets his first maximum.
Flatter ball, pn off. Turned towards the leg side for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Soumya Sarkar lofts this high up in the air and it falls just short of Ryan Burl at long on. They take one.
Flatter ball, on off. Tucked towards the on side for one.
